CustomField.description: Exploration mode. While on, an eligible customer can sign in and browse the villas they qualify for, but nothing can be booked, the 7-day clock does not start and declaration consent is not recorded. A standing notice tells the customer the site is open for exploration only. Replaced Reservations_Open_At__c on 26 Aug 2026: a tick box rather than a future date, so the state is readable at a glance. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Exploration Mode
